name: jobbsvep-app
description: Jobbsvep as an iPhone and Android app. Wraps the same web code as the website with Capacitor.

scripts.web: cd .. && JOBBSVEP_API=${JOBBSVEP_API:-https://jobbsvep-api.fly.dev} APP_DATA_BASE=${APP_DATA_BASE:-https://claudeabuser1.github.io/jobbsvep/} python3 scripts/build_site.py && rm -rf app/www && mkdir -p app/www && cp site/index.html app/www/ && cp -R site/en site/icons site/manifest.webmanifest app/www/
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
